name: Video timeline cut
oneLiner: a glass video editor: clips cut from the brand's own media drop and snap onto three tracks, the playhead scrubs with the monitor and timecode following, the blade drops through a clip with a click, the dead part lifts out and the timeline ripples shut
say: when the speaker talks about editing or cutting their videos ('I cut every pause', 'it edits the whole thing for me', 'the dead air is gone'): the clips snap in while they set it up, the cut lands on 'cut' or 'gone'
